What if your family had superpowers? Dad has super strength. He opens a jar of pickles... and rips the fridge door off.
Who makes these fridge doors so weak?!
Mom has super speed. Dinner is ready before you sit down. And your homework. All wrong, but very fast.
Your sister can read minds. Especially yours.
You ate the last cookie. I know.
And your superpower? You are invisible. Nobody even notices you are gone.
And that's why your family should never get superpowers.
